name: Afekt Metelyka
source:
Have you thought of fixing the present by changing the past? Have you thought about how it will be?

Our heroine thought about it, ans she was even answered? What will come of it? Will she kill Putin? Anyone else? What lesson will she learn from her adventure? Was it even there?

[Translated from [url=https://hiddenghoststudio.itch.io/butterfly-affect]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你有没有想过通过改变过去来改变现在？你有想过会怎样吗？

我们的女主角想了想，她竟然得到了回应？结果会怎样呢？她会杀普京吗？还有其他人吗？她将从这次冒险中学到什么教训？它甚至在那里吗？

[翻译自[url=https://hiddenghoststudio.itch.io/butterfly-affect]itch.io[/url]]
